description: This file defines the UserAgentMiddleware class, which constructs and injects User-Agent headers into AWS SDK HTTP requests. It includes methods for building various parts of the User-Agent string, handles middleware wrapping, and manages metrics related to endpoint discovery, retries, and environment information.

classes.name: UserAgentMiddleware
classes.description: Middleware responsible for constructing and injecting detailed User-Agent headers into AWS SDK HTTP requests, including version, environment, and retry metrics.

methods.name: wrap
methods.description: Returns a middleware wrapper function that, when invoked, creates an instance of UserAgentMiddleware with the provided handler and arguments.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the next handler and optional arguments for middleware operation.

methods.name: __invoke
methods.description: Middleware invocation that injects the User-Agent header into the request before passing it to the next handler.

methods.name: requestWithUserAgentHeader
methods.description: Builds the User-Agent header value from various functions and injects it into the request headers.

methods.name: buildUserAgentValue
methods.description: Generates an array of User-Agent string components by calling specified functions.

methods.name: getOsName
methods.description: Returns OS name and version string.

methods.name: getExecEnv
methods.description: Returns execution environment string if set.

methods.name: getEndpointDiscovery
methods.description: Returns endpoint discovery involvement string based on configuration.

methods.name: getAppId
methods.description: Returns application ID string if specified.

methods.name: getMetrics
methods.description: Generates metrics string if metrics are available.

methods.name: appendEndpointMetric
methods.description: Appends endpoint override metric if a custom endpoint is used.

methods.name: appendAccountIdModeMetric
methods.description: Appends account ID mode metric based on client configuration.

methods.name: appendRetryConfigMetric
methods.description: Appends retry mode metric based on retry configuration.
